title: API: the removed Part Library create calls return 404 and an in-use entry cannot be deleted
custom_preconds:
• API calls replayed from DevTools with header X-Location-ID = your location.
  • An entry stocked at this location (in use).
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/parts-catalogue/add-catalogue-part {"name":"Typed","partNumber":"NEW-1","tags":[]}.
  2. GET /api/parts-catalogue/catalogue-parts-that-are-not-on-location.
  3. POST /api/parts-catalogue/remove-catalogue-part for the in-use entry.
  4. GET /api/inventory/parts/list-workplaces?catalogPart={entry id} for an entry inactive at this location.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • 404; no entry NEW-1 is created.

Step 2:

  • 404.

Step 3:

  • 400 "This Part Library entry is in use and cannot be deleted."

Step 4:

  • 200; that location row has isActive false (and isTracked false for an untracked row).
